name: Ucore Rare Metals Inc.
summary: Ucore Rare Metals Inc. engages in the extraction, beneficiation, and separation of rare and critical metal resources in Canada. It primarily holds a 100% interest in the Bokan-Dotson Ridge rare earth element project located in Alaska, United States. The company was formerly known as Ucore Uranium Inc. and changed its name to Ucore Rare Metals Inc. in June 2010. Ucore Rare Metals Inc. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Bedford, Canada.
